items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: as a trombonist, he was one of my inspirations too

ctx.x: Marvelous breath control, you know, as a trombonist, he was one of my inspirations too, I should have mentioned him earlier, but he was such a great ballad player you know. And he had such control, I mean he could play right up in front of the microphone, very, very softly and let the microphone do a lot of work. But he had great control and beautiful sound.
Was he a good guy to work for?
